title: FRIEDA: BENCHMARKING MULTI-STEP CARTOGRAPHIC REASONING IN VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying and documenting the geographic distribution of source maps by country and continent to identify the overrepresentation of English-speaking regions.
Documenting the dataset's English-language focus and the deliberate restriction to documents using Latin characters, noting the exclusion of non-English conventions.

Categorizing the dataset maps into specific thematic domains (e.g., planning, environmental, geology, disaster) and evaluating model performance across these subsets to assess task and stylistic skews.
